rationale: Base fa3456ec. AD-313 (issue 874) adds collection protocol 9 and test-source exclusion for Python and TypeScript Explore. Measured with validate --against origin/main: calls_unresolved rises from 965 to 981 (net +16) and no other budget changes. The new calls are method calls on paths and strings in python/explore_scope, selected_scope and ir.profiles.is_test_source; code that moved keeps its own calls. Widenings: component analyzer requires ir through profiles:is_test_source; component ir and component profiles gain public profiles:is_test_source; component ir gains public import_gaps:derived_unresolved_imports. New modules join existing components: python explore_scope (entry), typescript explore_scope (input), typescript script_publication (source), analyzer selected_scope (process), check source_roots (workflows), ir import_gaps (facts) and ir scope_wire (protocol); each public name that other components use is listed, for example typescript explore_scope:is_test_path and explore_scope:emptied_by_exclusion. ir.json declares SourceScope.exclude_test_sources. The two type-ignore allowances in analyzer.process.is_process_alive move from lines 483 and 495 to 479 and 491; function, statement and tag stay the same. The digests bind the complete contract tree and baseline of fa3456ec to the head of this branch.
